definitions: To be taught or impressed upon someone repeatedly and thoroughly, often to the point of memorization or ingrained habit.
To have an idea, rule, or behavior firmly established in one's mind through persistent instruction or experience.
examples: The importance of saving money was drilled into me from a young age.
Safety protocols were drilled into me during my training.
It was drilled into me that honesty is the best policy.
The correct way to hold a tennis racket was drilled into me by my coach.
